title: GDPR: anonymize or fully delete a member
notes: Admins can now honour a “delete my account” request two ways from Admin → Members: Anonymize erases a member's personal data (name, email, avatar, bio, IPs) while keeping their posts as “Deleted user”, or Delete account & content removes the member and everything they authored.

changelog.text: Anonymize a member — erase their personal data but keep their posts & topics (shown as “Deleted user”). The recommended way to honour a GDPR deletion request.
Delete account & content — fully remove a member and everything they authored.
Member deletion is now explicit and correct (the old single “Delete” silently kept orphaned posts).
